contractFindings: Both controls completed all nine requested development runs without final-answer truncation.
All 36 swarm stages satisfied their provider-enforced JSON Schema contracts.
The warmed AWS endpoint sustained approximately 95 generated tokens per second in both controls.
Swarm used 2.3 times the wall time and 2.9 times the output tokens of Direct Qwen on these missions.
preliminaryQualityAudit: Both controls consistently selected the controlling churn target and separated verified from uncollected MRR.
Direct Qwen was deterministic across all three repetitions for each mission.
Swarm surfaced explicit confidence and unresolved risks, but one funnel repetition misstated the largest absolute loss and some growth-plan risks cited unsupported industry benchmarks.
The visible development cases are too easy and too few to establish a quality winner.
